source: World English Bible (US edition), public domain

verses.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.encouragement: Every verse you hide in your heart today is one you can draw on tomorrow.

verses.text: It is because of Yahweh's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn't fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verses.encouragement: His mercies are new every morning, and so is today's chance to meet Him in the Word.

verses.text: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
verses.encouragement: Day and night starts with a few minutes today.

verses.text: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of the mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
verses.encouragement: The Bereans searched the Scriptures daily. Join them today.

verses.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verses.encouragement: A lamp lights the next step. Let today's verse light yours.

verses.text: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.’”
verses.encouragement: You eat every day. Feed on the Word every day too.

verses.text: but his delight is in Yahweh's law. On his law he meditates day and night.
verses.encouragement: Delight grows with time. Take a moment with the Word today.

verses.text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
verses.encouragement: The Word dwells richly where it is welcomed daily.

verses.text: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
verses.encouragement: Give the first minutes of your day to Him.

verses.text: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.
verses.encouragement: Time in the Word is never wasted. It stands forever.

verses.text: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart; and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
verses.encouragement: Carry today's verse with you, at home, on the road, morning and night.

verses.text: Oh how I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
verses.encouragement: Come back to your verse throughout the day.

verses.text: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.encouragement: The Word is living. Let it speak to you today.

verses.text: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
verses.encouragement: Start the morning listening for His lovingkindness.

verses.text: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
verses.encouragement: Let His words make their home in you, one verse at a time.

verses.text: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
verses.encouragement: Taste and see. A few minutes in the Word can sweeten the whole day.

verses.text: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
verses.encouragement: Every verse you learn equips you for what today holds.

verses.text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the delight of my heart; for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.
verses.encouragement: Find joy in the Word today. It is food for the soul.

verses.text: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.encouragement: Faith grows as you hear the Word. Give it your ear today.

verses.text: My eyes are awake before the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
verses.encouragement: Even a quiet moment before sleep is time well spent in the Word.

verses.text: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow in respect to salvation,
verses.encouragement: Growth comes from daily nourishment. Take in the Word today.

verses.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation.
verses.encouragement: He blesses daily. Answer with a few minutes in His Word.

verses.text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
verses.encouragement: Jesus made room for time with the Father. Make room today.

verses.text: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.encouragement: Open the Word and let in the light.

verses.text: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
verses.encouragement: The Word you hold onto today will not return void.

verses.text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples. You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
verses.encouragement: Continue in the Word, and it will keep setting you free.

verses.text: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
verses.encouragement: Ask Him to open your eyes as you review today.

verses.text: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.encouragement: Trust Him with today, and let His Word direct your steps.

verses.text: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed, properly handling the word of truth.
verses.encouragement: Study is faithfulness in small steps. Take one today.

verses.text: Yahweh's law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh's testimony is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.encouragement: The Word restores. Come and be refreshed.

verses.text: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deceiving your own selves.
verses.encouragement: Knowing the Word by heart helps you live it out when it counts.
